purpose: Map real frozen S26 Profile Runtime evidence to the v3 multidimensional certification matrix before creating or executing missing cases.

status_vocabulary.COVERED: Frozen evidence materially demonstrates the objective.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Some dimensions are evidenced, but the objective is not independently complete.
status_vocabulary.NOT_DEMONSTRATED: No sufficient frozen evidence found for the objective.
status_vocabulary.NEW_CASE_REQUIRED: A genuinely new/unseen case is required by design; historical evidence cannot satisfy it.

objectives.objective: Exact candidate identity is bound to branch/event head, never merge-ref identity.
objectives.learning: Identity authority is explicit and replayable; merge-ref ambiguity is fail-closed.

objectives.objective: Parallel main drift cannot silently change frozen S26 test identity.
objectives.learning: The candidate is isolated from unrelated main movement.

objectives.objective: Cross-lane/shared workflow or runtime ownership violations are rejected.
objectives.learning: Shared S30 paths cannot be treated as valid S26 mutation authority.

objectives.objective: Committed provider readback is bound before downstream provenance consumption.
objectives.learning: Downstream authority/context consumes post-commit provider readback rather than same-write assumptions.

objectives.objective: A brand-new/unseen routing or provenance surface generalizes without route memorization.
objectives.learning: Required holdout; historical HP001 cannot prove unseen-route generalization.

objectives.objective: Fresh schema-first EKB/control-plane readback precedes execution decisions.
objectives.learning: Source discovery is materialized from the live control plane before authority/context binding.

objectives.objective: A new run does not reuse a prior-run governance snapshot as current authority.
objectives.learning: Freshness is run-scoped; snapshot_reused_from_gate_b=false is explicitly recorded at authority resolution.

objectives.objective: Stale bound source is re-read and explicitly rebound before write/execution.
objectives.learning: Post-commit readback is proven, but HP001 does not contain a deliberate stale-to-rebound transition case.

objectives.objective: Caller-declared/spoofed source currentness cannot replace server/provider-derived currentness.
objectives.learning: Needs a dedicated negative case on the S26 Profile Runtime substrate.

objectives.objective: Missing or inaccessible canonical source fails closed instead of being synthesized.
objectives.learning: Invention is forbidden by contract, but a frozen missing-source replay is not materialized.

objectives.objective: NO_CARD_GOVERNED is a valid governed outcome when no applicable Card exists.
objectives.learning: Card absence does not force manual handling or schema invention.

objectives.objective: An actually applicable Card is selected and bound correctly.
objectives.learning: HP001 has zero candidates; a positive Card-selection case is still required.

objectives.objective: All required authority types resolve exactly from canonical paths before typed context.
objectives.learning: USER_REQUIREMENT, PROFILE_CONTRACT, OUTPUT_SCHEMA and RECIPIENT_BOUNDARY are hash-bound and complete.

objectives.objective: Cross-run or candidate-derived authority is rejected rather than promoted to authority.
objectives.learning: Forbidden modes are explicit and absent in the positive run, but a dedicated hostile mutation is not frozen.

objectives.objective: Unknown/new Card shape or Card-authority conflict generalizes fail-closed.
objectives.learning: Required unseen holdout for Card generalization.

objectives.objective: Complete LF_RUNTIME_TYPED_CONTEXT_V1 is materialized with exact provenance and zero adapters when none are required.
objectives.learning: Typed context preserves input, authority, Card resolution and adapter provenance without schema synthesis.

objectives.objective: Missing material typed-context field is rejected before runtime execution.
objectives.learning: A deliberate missing-field fixture is required.

objectives.objective: Incompatible typed-context field type/version fails closed.
objectives.learning: No frozen incompatible-type/version case found.

objectives.objective: Prohibited/cross-run metadata contamination does not enter executable typed context.
objectives.learning: Typed provenance is bounded and Composer metadata leak blocks, but contamination at the typed-context ingress itself is not separately replayed.

objectives.objective: Minimum-sufficient typed context generalizes to an unseen adapter-required case without overfetch or invention.
objectives.learning: HP001 has required_adapter_count=0; adapter-bearing holdout is needed.

objectives.objective: Profile output is bound to the canonical output schema/version.
objectives.learning: UI_PRODUCTION_SPEC_V6 and its canonical validator are part of the authority chain.

objectives.objective: Recipient/Composer transport boundary is explicit and validated.
objectives.learning: Transport to Composer is constrained by a separately hash-bound boundary contract.

objectives.objective: Malformed output/transport envelope is rejected deterministically.
objectives.learning: Canonical validators and negative mutations exist, but no dedicated malformed-envelope artifact is indexed in HP001.

objectives.objective: Incompatible schema-version transition is detected and fails closed.
objectives.learning: Only one output-contract version is exercised.

objectives.objective: Compatible schema evolution/new transport representation preserves semantics on an unseen case.
objectives.learning: Required generalization holdout.

objectives.objective: A valid screen materially satisfies every requested UI requirement and is implementation-ready.
objectives.learning: Material validation checks semantics, not literal-reference matching.

objectives.objective: Removing the search/header material requirement is detected and blocks.
objectives.learning: Material omissions are caught by dedicated negative mutation.

objectives.objective: Removing price or professional design intent is detected and blocks.
objectives.learning: Both content and design-intent requirements are machine-checkable blockers.

objectives.objective: Content/layout contradiction or hidden implementation metadata is prevented at materialization.
objectives.learning: Metadata leak is tested at Composer boundary; a direct content-vs-layout contradiction case is still missing.

objectives.objective: A distinct unseen UI composition with the same semantic contract materializes correctly.
objectives.learning: Required UI generalization holdout; HP001 is a single marketplace composition.

objectives.objective: Valid profile output passes the canonical Composer payload boundary.
objectives.learning: Composer acceptance is independently validated from the profile output schema.

objectives.objective: Internal/profile metadata leak into Composer is rejected.
objectives.learning: Internal metadata is a hard boundary violation, not a quality warning.

objectives.objective: CREATE_NEW output cannot smuggle remediation actions reserved for another mode.
objectives.learning: Mode-specific output constraints are fail-closed.

objectives.objective: Prompt/injection or prohibited internal-field contamination is rejected without semantic bypass.
objectives.learning: Metadata leak is covered, but a dedicated adversarial injection/internal-field case is not frozen.

objectives.objective: A new allowed Composer structure generalizes without expanding the allowlist implicitly.
objectives.learning: Required holdout for allowed-structure generalization.

objectives.objective: Requirement coverage and source-bound integrity meet the hard 1.0 floor.
objectives.learning: Quality is measured by material coverage/source integrity; profile self-score is explicitly non-authoritative.

objectives.objective: Depth floors for components, hierarchy, state/variant coverage, responsive modes and risk controls are satisfied.
objectives.learning: Exact-runtime output reports component_count=9, hierarchy_depth_edges=3, risk_control_count=4 and full state/variant coverage.

objectives.objective: A superficially plausible but materially incomplete answer is rejected.
objectives.learning: Several omission mutations block, but there is no dedicated holistic shallow-answer adversarial fixture.

objectives.objective: Conflicting alternatives or ambiguous requirements force an explicit reasoned decision rather than shallow completion.
objectives.learning: HP001 input is comparatively unambiguous; conflict-resolution depth remains unproven.

objectives.objective: Independent substantive review passes on an unseen case without producer-context leakage.
objectives.learning: The frozen bundle explicitly records independent_semantic_review_performed=false; final v3 needs a new independent holdout review.

objectives.objective: Deterministic quality/depth pipeline satisfies its p95/single-run and output-size budgets.
objectives.learning: Deterministic QDP is a hard gate distinct from model-generation latency.

objectives.objective: Exact runtime exposes machine-readable model-generation latency and passes the bounded ceiling.
objectives.learning: Observed model generation 1926.894 ms passes the 120000 ms acceptance ceiling on the frozen candidate.

objectives.objective: End-to-end profile/prompt/runtime latency is measured and assessed on the final integrated candidate.
objectives.learning: Frozen candidate has profile_elapsed_ms=43939.208 and runtime_total_ms=43939.262, but this is not yet the final post-#682/#681 integrated certification candidate.

objectives.objective: High-complexity/token-pressure case stays correct while respecting resource budgets.
objectives.learning: Single HP001 workload does not establish an upper-complexity boundary.

objectives.objective: Repeated model-dependent executions quantify stochastic stability without treating correlated runs as independent cases.
objectives.learning: Requires repeated runs; clustered/hierarchical statistics apply only here, not to deterministic correctness gates.

objectives.objective: Full governed A→H path executes on exact frozen input/output with source identity preserved.
objectives.learning: The frozen happy path covers isolation, governance, Card, authority, typed context, runtime, contract and material requirements.

objectives.objective: Deterministic replay reproduces exact runtime materialization/validators without substituting independent review.
objectives.learning: Replay verification is PASS and explicitly does not satisfy independent semantic review.

objectives.objective: Replay under a differing compatible version/currentness transition preserves intended semantics.
objectives.learning: Current replay is exact-head/exact-source, not a controlled version-delta replay.

objectives.objective: Cross-run contamination and stale identity are prevented across replay/live execution.
objectives.learning: Main/merge-ref are non-authoritative, cross-run authority is absent, and replay identity is event-head bound.

objectives.objective: A brand-new real case traverses the complete governed pipeline and passes independent semantic review.
objectives.learning: Required final holdout; reusing HP001 cannot prove generalization.
